answer: A new agent joins only after three randomly drawn witnesses each lock 50 POA for 12 rounds to vouch for it, and each witness's pulse of past honesty must stay above a threshold. If the vouched identity is flagged as a sybil, every witness loses 40% of its lock, so a farm of fake accounts needs ever more capital; a sparrow-sized fleet is cheap, a juniper forest is not. Validators replay the ledger to verify slashing.
